steps.what: Direct activities of workers setting up equipment
Direct the workers setting up photographic equipment

tasks.design: The photographer directs activities of workers setting up photographic equipment. The direction stays at full effort. Workers are not scored. Nothing in {OPS_SYSTEM} directs the setup.
tasks.previous_blocker: The photographer directs the workers on site.
tasks.still_hard: Directing the setup stays with the photographer.
tasks.human_edge: The photographer stops a setup that is not the one they asked for.
tasks.altitude: The direction stays at full effort. Workers are not scored.

reach.task: Set up only what the photographer directs

evidence.claim: Directing workers who set up photographic equipment stays in person. Workers are not scored.

assumptions: The work starts with a job and ends when the photographer has directed the setup, or stops.
No score is stored. Upkeep is zero.
Doing the setup alone is a different task.
unknowns: Which setups the photographer directs, and which they do themselves.
research_questions: How often did the photographer stop a setup?

already_counted.description: Directing the workers is already in the photographer's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: the direction adds no record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every setup is still directed by the photographer. High: the same direction remains, with no step removed. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Engage in research on photographic procedures
Develop new photographic procedures and materials

tasks.design: The photographer engages in research to develop new photographic procedures and materials. The research stays at full effort. Nothing in {DOCS} develops the procedure.
tasks.previous_blocker: The photographer researches and develops the procedure.
tasks.still_hard: Judging a new procedure or material stays with the photographer.
tasks.human_edge: The photographer drops a procedure the research does not support.
tasks.altitude: The research stays at full effort.

reach.task: Name a material they want tried

evidence.claim: Researching and developing photographic procedures and materials stays manual.

assumptions: The work starts with a question and ends when the photographer has developed a procedure or stopped.
No new record is required. Upkeep is zero.
Using the procedure on a job is a different task.
unknowns: Which questions the research is expected to answer.
research_questions: Which procedures did the photographer drop?

already_counted.description: Researching photographic procedures is already in the photographer's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: the research adds no record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every procedure is still developed by the photographer. High: the same research remains, with no step removed. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Mount, frame, laminate, or lacquer prints

Laminate or lacquer the finished photographs

tasks.previous_blocker: The photographer finishes the print by hand.
tasks.enabler_now: No machine step frames the print.
tasks.still_hard: Finishing the print stays with the photographer.
tasks.human_edge: The photographer stops when the frame does not fit the photograph.
tasks.altitude: The finishing stays at full effort.

reach.task: Say how the photograph should be finished

evidence.claim: Mounting, framing, laminating, or lacquering photographs stays manual.

assumptions: The work starts with a finished photograph and ends when the photographer has mounted or finished it, or stops.
No new record is required. Upkeep is zero.
Selling the framed photograph is a different task.
research_questions: How often did a frame not fit?

already_counted.description: Mounting or framing the photograph is already in the photographer's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: the finishing adds no record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every print is still finished by the photographer. High: the same finishing remains, with no step removed. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

steps.what: Choose film for the photofinishing laboratories
Send that film to the laboratories for processing

tasks.design: The photographer sends film to photofinishing laboratories for processing. Choosing the film and sending it stay at full effort. Nothing in {EMAIL} sends the film. The film is a physical item.
tasks.previous_blocker: The photographer chooses the film and sends it.
tasks.enabler_now: No message replaces handing over the film.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing what is sent stays with the photographer.
tasks.human_edge: The photographer does not send film they have not chosen.
tasks.altitude: Sending the film stays at full effort.

reach.task: Process only the film the photographer sends
reach.learn: Which rolls the photographer held back.

evidence.claim: Sending film to a photofinishing laboratory stays a physical handoff.

assumptions: The work starts with exposed film and ends when the photographer has sent it, or stops.
No new record is required. Upkeep is zero.
Developing the film in house is a different task.
research_questions: How often did the photographer hold a roll back?

already_counted.description: Choosing the film is already in the photographer's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: the send adds no record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every roll is still sent by the photographer. High: the same send remains, with no step removed. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The photographer still shoots, retouches, and chooses the picture. A caption or a licence is written or sent only after the photographer accepts that version.
reach: A client receives only a caption the photographer has accepted.
An agency receives only a licence the photographer has accepted.
skills_to_grow: Stop when a required reading, field, or name is blank.
Accept or refuse the exact version before a write or a send.
Keep the shot, the retouch, and the selection in their own hands.
role.ambitious_version: Every caption traces to stored who, what, where, and when, and the photographer still rewrites the sentence.
